functions.description: Parse base crx-cli log line into timestamp, host, pid, severity and message
Extract user and source IP/host from 'user@ip' patterns in the message
Extract container name from single-quoted references in the message
Extract destination IPv6 address and port from network attachment messages
Extract source IPv4 address from 'from'/'source' phrases when no user@ip pattern present
Classify action based on message content, normalize severity, and derive protocol when a destination port is present

add.name: action
add.value: message.match(/created successfully/) ? 'create' : message.match(/create container/) ? 'create_request' : message.match(/Removed stopped container/) ? 'delete' : message.match(/stopped gracefully/) ? 'stop' : message.match(/Failed to pull image/) ? 'pull_failed' : message.match(/failed authentication attempts/) ? 'auth_failure' : message.match(/Volume mount/) ? 'mount_failed' : message.match(/exceeded memory/) ? 'resource_limit_exceeded' : message.match(/health check timeout/) ? 'health_check_failed' : message.match(/network attached/) ? 'network_attach' : message.match(/Suspicious container creation/) ? 'suspicious_activity' : message.match(/service restarted/) ? 'service_restart' : message.match(/requested list of running containers/) ? 'list_containers' : message.match(/resource limits/) ? 'start' : 'other'
